g.text: Where does site-direction removal change age-prediction error?
Color: paired change in age error at fixed α=1000; red = worse, blue = better. Numbers: unique participants. Gray: empty cell.
All external domains/ages retained; participant-balanced appearance losses. Small cells are descriptive, with no uncertainty claim.
[90,100] includes age100. Atlases use the same participants; these are not independent replications or causal effects.
